name: Baked Vegetable Kofta
ingredients: 1 cup grated carrot and cabbage, squeezed dry
½ tsp cumin and ½ tsp coriander powder
steps: Mix the vegetables, potato, besan, coriander, chilli, garam masala and salt. Shape into 10 balls.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes, turning halfway, until firm and lightly browned.
Heat the oil, add cumin, then cook the blended tomato-onion for 10 minutes with coriander powder.
Add 1½ cups water and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the koftas and simmer for 3 minutes before serving.
note: The potato binds the koftas; the besan adds protein.
